_doc: One House tuning (WP8: the numbers tools/house_lab.gd finds). Read over assets/data/one_house.json by OneHouse.data() KEY BY KEY (an object is merged with the same object of one_house.json, any other value replaces it; keys that start with an underscore are notes and are skipped), and its `field` block by TownSim when the sim is made (scripts/town/town_sim.gd `_apply_tuning`, which hands it to DormantDead.apply_tuning). A key that is not here keeps the base number. SCHEMA. night: {first, growth}: the first attack night's size as a multiple of the colony's ordinary night, and the growth of each night after it. start: {hour, stock: {ammo, scrap, food, water, meds}}: the first morning and the stores a run begins with. attack: {from_rescue, cutoff_hour}. big_night: {} or a Big Night theme (brutes) for the first attack night. field (the dead of the street, scripts/town/dormant_dead.gd): wake_r tiles within which a sleeping dead one wakes near a person by day (halved for one inside a house the person is not in); night_wake the multiplier of wake_r from dusk to dawn; noise_by_gun {shotgun, other, melee} the tiles a shot of that gun is heard within (a third of that from inside a house); noise_cap how many of the dead one shot can draw, the nearest first (they go to look at where it was fired, they are not sent after the shooter); sleep_r tiles from every living person beyond which an awake dead one that is not after anybody goes back to sleep; active_cap (leave it out: it is the platform's, scripts/town/town_perf.gd). NOT YET READ BY ANYONE: kits: {fence|fence_strong|gate|door_plank|tower|floodlight: {scrap, work, hp}} over assets/data/base_kits.json, for the perimeter to merge when it makes its kits; packs: {scale} a multiplier on what a rescued survivor brings, for the rescue module. EVIDENCE: tools/house_lab.gd --seeds=1..8 --mode=bot,idle prints the milestones and the verdicts; `--set=field.wake_r=12,field.noise_by_gun.shotgun=16,night.first=2` puts a number over a run in memory so that it can be tried before it is written here.

_tempo.what: TEMPO (2026-10-07, the first outside feedback: pace is too slow, everything needs to happen faster). The owner's words: not a shorter loop, a snappier one: the actions are quicker and the day is as long (attack.cutoff_hour stays 0). The knobs live in one_house.json `tempo` (read by OneHouse.tempo(key), town only), salvage.json `seconds_mult` and rescue.json. Every number was tried with the lab's --set=tempo.x=y before it was written.
changed: one_house.json tempo.walk_mult: 1.0 -> 1.12 (avatar walks 3.2 -> 3.58 tiles a second; the run stays 1.45 times that: 5.2 tiles a second)
one_house.json tempo.crew_walk_mult: 1.0 -> 1.12 (radio.gd speed_of: 3.0 -> 3.36, the hurry 3.7 -> 4.14: the crew keeps up with her)
one_house.json tempo.crew_build_mult: 1.0 -> 1.5 (build.gd rate: a crew builder does 1.5 builder-hours a game hour; her own hands, build_hands per_min 10, are unchanged)
one_house.json tempo.search_mult: 1.0 -> 0.625 (a container's search 4.0 -> 2.5 s: hers, the room search's and the crew's timer: search.gd search_secs)
one_house.json tempo.claim_s: 2.0 -> 1.0 (base.gd, the hold of E at the front door)
one_house.json tempo.bandage_s: 4.0 -> 3.0 and tempo.cure_s: 7.0 -> 5.0 (uses.gd, her own care)
one_house.json tempo.dead_speed_mult: 1.0 -> 1.0 (the knob is there: 1.15 cost the bot 3 of 32 first nights (30 -> 27) and idle 2 of 32, so the dead are as slow as they were)

one_house.json night.first: 1.0 -> 0.9 (the first night is 10 dead, it was 11: the quick search alone took the bot's first night from 57 to 54 of 64 seeds and its wall damage from 100 to 144 hp, the bot loots more of the street in the same day and wakes more of the dead; one dead fewer gives it back)
salvage.json seconds_mult: 1.0 -> 0.75 (strip: about 8 s of the hands for a scrap, it was 11; the crew's timer too)
rescue.json arrive_min: 3.0 -> 2.0 and arrive_per_tile: 0.4 -> 0.3 (game minutes: a survivor who said yes is at the door sooner)
room_search.gd HOLD_S: 0.6 -> 0.45 (the hold of E for the whole room)
hud.gd BANNER_FADE 0.7 -> 0.45 and BANNER_HOLD 3.0 -> 1.8 (the banner is up 2.7 s, it was 4.4)
town_hud.gd OPENING_HOLD_S: 5.0 -> 3.0 (the opening view of the entry before the camera comes to her)
_tempo.lab_before_after: seeds 1..16, human 1.25, medians of real minutes (bot): claim 2.5 -> 2.0, first fence 4.4 -> 3.8, two rescues 5.3 -> 4.6, the bell of the first attack 16.0 -> 16.0, held 23.2 -> 23.2 (the dusk pegs the arc). Phases: walk in to clear 0.7 -> 0.7, clear to claim (the search of the start house) 1.7 -> 1.2, claim to fence 1.9 -> 1.9 (her hands), claim to two rescues 2.7 -> 2.6, two rescues to the bell 10.9 -> 11.5 (mostly the wait for day 2's dusk), the night 7.2 -> 7.2. Claim hour median 11.0 -> 10.1 (latest 12.0 -> 10.5). First night held (bot / idle), seeds 1..16: before 15/16 and 4/16; with the quick actions and the old night of 11 dead 14/16 and 1/16; with the night of 10 dead 16/16 and 3/16 (seeds 17..32: 16/16 and 8/16 before, 15/16 and 4/16 after; over the 32 seeds 31/32 and 12/32 before, 31/32 and 7/32 after). One group of knobs at a time, bot, the old night: walking alone 30/32, the crew's walk and build alone 32/32, the quick search alone 54/64 against 57/64 (wall damage 144 hp against 100), which is why the night is a dead smaller.
